title: UK fixed-income market recommended closed all day for Easter Monday — the US bond market's first full session after Good Friday, run without London
source: NEWS: sifma.org/resources/guides-playbooks/holiday-schedule ('Holiday Schedule'), fetched direct 2026-09-05 (HTTP 200, 298,926 bytes) and read out of the page's embedded Next.js flight payload by this session, where the 2027 panels live behind a year tab a rendered-DOM parse never reaches. The U.K. 2027 panel's Easter Monday card reads exactly ['Easter Monday', 'Monday, March 29, 2027'] with NO early-close note attached — the full-closure shape, structurally distinct from the 'Early Close' cards elsewhere on the same page. The causing holiday is independently statutory: gov.uk/bank-holidays.json (HTTP 200, 22,207 bytes) lists '2027-03-29 | Easter Monday' in the england-and-wales division and in northern-ireland, and NOT in scotland. Cross-checked the same day against the page's U.S. panel, whose only March-2027 string is 'Early Close (2:00 p.m. Eastern Time): Thursday, March 25, 2027' and whose 2027 holidays run New Year's Day, MLK 01-18, Presidents 02-15, Good Friday 03-26, Memorial Day 05-31 — no 03-29 entry of any kind, so the recommended US fixed-income tape runs a full session while London is dark. Filed estimate on three counts, identical to the five sifma-* entries already on this calendar: the confirmed-prefix taxonomy in market-events-data.ts has no slot for an industry trade association's recommended schedule, this lane may not self-confirm an event it discovered in-sweep, and SIFMA's own page states its schedule is a recommendation rather than a market-wide halt each firm is bound by. Unlike its Japan-panel counterpart on the same date, this UK card carries NO 'Tentative' flag.
notes: DISCOVERED during the sifma-japan-early-close-2027-03-29 initial research (2026-09-05). WHY IT EARNS A ROW: it is the CAUSE of the Japan-panel entry already tracked on this date, and it mirrors the accepted sifma-uk-bond-market-closure-2026-12-28 precedent exactly. SCOPE, stated because a sibling entry was originally filed with the wrong reading of it: SIFMA's page says verbatim that 'All SIFMA holiday recommendations apply to the trading of U.S. dollar-denominated government securities...', so every regional panel is a TIME ZONE, not an asset class — this is the London session of the US DOLLAR bond market recommended shut, and UK gilts are out of scope entirely. THE THREE-REGION STATE ON 2027-03-29: UK fully shut (this entry) - Japan 15:00 JST early close, tentative (sifma-japan-early-close-2027-03-29) - US a full session (no card). That is the same inverted triple the 2026-12-28 pair produced, and it instantiates the naming rule this calendar's Japan entries now document: a US holiday shuts Tokyo's dollar desk in full, a UK-only bank holiday halves it. IMPACT LOW: nothing UK-listed is closed by this recommendation (LSE's own equity and gilt hours are not SIFMA's to set, and gov.uk's statutory Easter Monday is what actually shuts London), no house playbook is calendar-, holiday- or rates-keyed (both playbook docs grepped this session for 'holiday|jpx|tokyo|nikkei|closure|jgb|gilt|sifma|easter|fiscal year|ex-dividend': zero hits), and this repo tracks no UK-listed symbol or gilt instrument. HONEST LIMIT: the statutory holiday covers England-and-Wales and Northern Ireland but NOT Scotland, so 'the UK is shut' is true of the venue that matters and not uniformly true; and SIFMA's recommendation is non-binding by its own terms. CORRIDOR CONTEXT: this date already carries boj-summary-of-opinions-2027-03-29 (08:50 JST), ftc-v-amazon-antitrust-trial-2027-03-29 and the Japan early close, and it is the third-to-last Tokyo session of the Japanese fiscal year (FY2026 ends 2027-03-31). AMENDED 2026-09-05 by this entry's own initial research (docs/research/events/sifma-uk-bond-market-closure-2027-03-29.md), which re-fetched every primary rather than inheriting them and built its market study on a different source and asset class from the sibling's (US rates via the Federal Reserve's H.15 series on FRED, not Japanese equities via Yahoo). THE TITLE NOW LEADS WITH THE REOPENING because that is the larger fact about this date for the tape we would actually trade and it was missed at filing: SIFMA's U.S. 2027 panel recommends a FULL close on Good Friday 2027-03-26 plus a 2:00 p.m. ET early close on 03-25, so 2027-03-29 is the first full US bond session after a three-day weekend, conducted with London dark. PANEL ATTRIBUTION, done positionally rather than by heading proximity: the payload's Easter Monday / Monday, March 29, 2027 / EMPTY-NOTE triple sits between Good Friday / Friday, March 26, 2027 and May Day / Monday, May 3, 2027 in the block that also carries Spring Bank Holiday and Summer Bank Holiday / Monday, August 30, 2027 — cards the U.S. panel does not have. NO TENTATIVE FLAG, CONFIRMED: the string Tentative - Subject to confirmation by the Bank of Japan appears only on Japan-panel cards, never in the U.K. panel in either year, so this entry's durability call sits ABOVE the co-dated sifma-japan-early-close-2027-03-29. PANEL ACCURACY MEASURED, 6 of 6 then 0 of 2: against gov.uk's eight statutory England-and-Wales 2027 dates the U.K. panel is right on 01-01, 03-26, 03-29, 05-03, 05-31 and 08-30, and wrong on BOTH December substitutes (its Christmas card reads Friday, December 24, 2027 against the statutory Mon 12-27; its Boxing Day card reads None against Tue 12-28); it also lists Juneteenth on Sat 2027-06-19 and U.S. Independence Day on Sun 2027-07-04 where the U.S. panel substitutes forward to Monday, July 5, 2027. The year-end inconsistency the Japan sibling flagged is LOCATED HERE, in the U.K. block — a refinement of its leg 14 — and this date sits in the verified half. NEW STRUCTURAL PROOF OF SCOPE, which both sibling lanes rested on a single quoted sentence: the U.K. panel schedules closures for Martin Luther King Day, Presidents Day, Juneteenth, US Independence Day, Labor Day, Columbus Day, Veterans Day and Thanksgiving alongside the six UK bank holidays — A GILT CALENDAR DOES NOT CLOSE FOR MLK DAY — so U.S. dollar-denominated is proven by the panel's own contents, not merely quoted. US TAPE, from a Federal Reserve primary: FRED DGS10 (H.15, HTTP 200, 268,603 bytes) carries an observation on 37 of 37 Easter Mondays 1990-2026, so the US bond market is open every time and that leg no longer rests on SIFMA's silence; 28 of those 37 Good Fridays have NO DGS10 observation (a full close) and 9 do (open/shortened — SIFMA's own 2026 card is Early Close (12:00 p.m. Eastern Time): Friday, April 3, 2026), and 2027 is the n=28 shape. MEASURED NULL, the cleanest cross-lane result on this date: |change in 10y| on Easter Mondays is 5.22bp against a same-weekday same-months control of 4.01bp (n=286), Welch t = 0.98 and t = 0.19 on 2000+ — the variance DAMPENING the Japan sibling measured in the Tokyo equity bar at t = -2.86 DOES NOT TRANSFER to US rates. MEASURED AND REFUSED: signed 10y change +3.76bp with 25 of 37 up (67.6%) vs control +0.01bp / 44.4%, Welch t = 2.71 and sign z = 2.84, still t = 2.59 ex the two biggest movers — but 1990-1999 alone carries +7.0bp, 2010+ falls to +2.12bp at t = 1.75 / z = 0.95 / t = 0.99 ex-outliers, and the 2y does not replicate the up-rate (15/37, median 0.0bp), leaving only a mild steepening (10y-2y +1.16bp, t = 2.47). Recorded at Low as an n-generator, sized at zero. HONEST LIMIT ADDED: LSE's own 2027 trading calendar was PROBED AND NOT OBTAINED (londonstockexchange.com/equities-trading/business-days, HTTP 200, 54,995 bytes, a JavaScript shell whose served HTML contains no 2027 / Easter / holiday string), so nothing is asserted here about LSE or gilt hours beyond the statutory gov.uk bank holiday; and a close-to-close H.15 quote cannot see liquidity, volume or spread, so the null above is a PRICE null and not a liquidity one. CORRIDOR NOTE the sibling read only from Tokyo: 2027-03-31 is the US CALENDAR-QUARTER END as well as the Japanese fiscal year-end, so 03-29 is T-2 into both.
